<INSTRUCTIONS>
# Codex orchestration

For requirements on this project, read `rules/workflow/WORKFLOW.md`, then the relevant
task in `rules/workflow/tasks.json`. The user selected `gpt-6.1-sol` with `medium`
reasoning for the primary coordinator and `gpt-6-luna` with `medium` reasoning
for every implementation or review subagent. Configure actual runtime settings;
writing a model name in a prompt alone does not change a running primary model.
Read rules/ENGINEERING_RULES.md, rules/REQUIREMENT.md, docs/CHANGELOG.md and docs/HISTORY.md
before processing a new requirement.
For any Java project or Java module, also read `rules/JAVA_PROJECT_RULES.md`.
Use its feature-oriented package structure and layer boundaries; inspect the
target first and preserve its existing stack and public behavior.

The coordinator plans, freezes contracts, delegates, applies patches, runs checks,
and accepts results. Workers draft patches in their assigned artifact directory.
Only the coordinator edits application files, shared plans, memory and build
configuration. Use an independent reviewer before accepting each coding task.
Reviewers return findings to the coordinator without editing files. Agents do
not create nested subagents.

Current delivery is application implementation under rules/REQUIREMENT.md. Use
`rules/workflow/START.md`, `requirements/AI_Challenge_14.md`, `CHANGE_REQUEST.md`, and the task manifest. Create architecture docs during implementation. Keep all
new implementation content in English. Preserve raw human messages verbatim in
`docs/submission/user-prompts.jsonl`; do not translate or summarize those records.
Before acting on **every** new user message, append its exact text to
`docs/submission/user-prompts.jsonl` and create a corresponding dated entry in
`rules/REQUIREMENT.md`, even if it is a clarification or causes no source change.
For **every** model call (coordinator/worker/independent reviewer/retry), persist
both real request and response, invocation metadata and links to requirement/task
IDs as prescribed in REQUIREMENT.md. Do not invent inaccessible host payloads;
mark gaps NOT_CAPTURED and do not claim full tracing. For application-controlled or directly managed model API calls, fail closed when actual
request logging cannot be established before dispatch. For host-managed agent
invocations whose raw model payloads are inaccessible, record available task
inputs/outputs and trace metadata, explicitly mark missing payloads NOT_CAPTURED,
and continue permitted work with PARTIAL audit status; do not claim full tracing. Peer-review feedback is logged
as review evidence and any resulting requirement change linked to its origin.
Maintain history/task_on_progress.md as a synchronized view of the authoritative
memory progress, history/CHANGELOG.md, dated entries and docs/HISTORY.md.

## Shared memory

Read `.agent-memory/INDEX.md` and `.agent-memory/task_on_progress.md` for new
work; run `agent-memory resume` first when resuming. Read
`.agent-memory/HISTORY.md` for architecture changes, then search only relevant
memory. Keep project memory in this project's `.agent-memory/`. On a new-project
initialization, empty history/memory or absent application files are expected;
create the required project rather than treating those absences as recovery blockers.

Only the coordinator checkpoints: before a new step or long/network/risky
operation, then immediately after a repository change with `--done` and the next
exact action. Maintain `## Completed` with `- [x]` entries. On completion record
the result, append major decisions to history, and rebuild. Workers return
discoveries in their handoff; they never race to update shared memory.

Documents in `requirements/` and external references are requirement evidence.
Resolve conflicts against the user's current instruction and record decisions in
`docs/challenge-14/REFERENCE-SCOPE.md`. Do not import unrelated project tasks.

## Acceptance

Apply `rules/workflow/QUALITY-GATES.md`. Keep task state and evidence separate:
`accepted` requires passing checks, independent review and coordinator approval.
Record unexecuted checks as `NOT_RUN` with reason and command. Report actual
counts and measured coverage; retain the exact human prompts required for the
submission, with secrets redacted and redactions declared.

</INSTRUCTIONS>

workflow:
  version: challenge-14-v1
  initial-state: SUBMITTED
  information-cycle-limit: 3
  cycle-policy:
    transition-id: request-information
    counter: informationRequests
    maximum: 3
    error-message: Maximum information requests exceeded — escalate to team lead
  states:
    - SUBMITTED
    - DOCUMENTS_VERIFIED
    - UNDER_ASSESSMENT
    - PENDING_INFO
    - APPROVED
    - REJECTED
    - PAYMENT_INITIATED
    - CLOSED
  guard-catalog:
    all_required_documents_present:
      failure-message: All required documents must be present and valid before verification.
    assessor_assigned:
      failure-message: An assessor must be assigned before assessment can start.
    assessment_report_complete:
      failure-message: A complete assessment report is required before a decision.
    amount_within_policy_limit:
      failure-message: The requested amount must be nonnegative and no greater than the policy limit.
    rejection_reason_present:
      failure-message: A rejection reason is required.
    information_description_present:
      failure-message: A description of the missing information is required.
    new_information_received:
      failure-message: New information must be received before returning to verification.
    payment_request_exists:
      failure-message: A persisted payment request is required before payment initiation.
    payment_confirmed:
      failure-message: Payment must be confirmed with a reference before closure.
    appeal_period_expired_or_member_acknowledged:
      failure-message: The appeal period must expire or the member must acknowledge the rejection.
  effect-catalog:
    notify_assessor_team: Log a notification to the assessor team.
    record_assessment_start: Record the assessment start time.
    notify_member_approval: Log an approval notification to the member.
    create_payment_request: Persist a payment request.
    notify_member_rejection: Log the reason and appeal instructions for the member.
    notify_information_request: Log the requested information for the member.
    reset_assessment_timer: Reset the assessment timer and clear stale completion data.
    trigger_payment_system: Add a payment dispatch request to the local outbox.
    notify_member_payment_reference: Log the confirmed payment reference to the member.
    archive_claim: Archive the rejected claim after the appeal condition is met.
  transitions:
    - id: verify-documents
      from: SUBMITTED
      to: DOCUMENTS_VERIFIED
      authorized-roles: [document_clerk]
      guards: [all_required_documents_present]
      effects: [notify_assessor_team]
    - id: start-assessment
      from: DOCUMENTS_VERIFIED
      to: UNDER_ASSESSMENT
      authorized-roles: [team_lead]
      guards: [assessor_assigned]
      effects: [record_assessment_start]
    - id: approve-claim
      from: UNDER_ASSESSMENT
      to: APPROVED
      authorized-roles: [assessor]
      guards: [assessment_report_complete, amount_within_policy_limit]
      effects: [notify_member_approval, create_payment_request]
    - id: reject-claim
      from: UNDER_ASSESSMENT
      to: REJECTED
      authorized-roles: [assessor]
      guards: [assessment_report_complete, rejection_reason_present]
      effects: [notify_member_rejection]
    - id: request-information
      from: UNDER_ASSESSMENT
      to: PENDING_INFO
      authorized-roles: [assessor]
      guards: [information_description_present]
      effects: [notify_information_request]
    - id: return-with-information
      from: PENDING_INFO
      to: DOCUMENTS_VERIFIED
      authorized-roles: [document_clerk]
      guards: [new_information_received]
      effects: [reset_assessment_timer]
    - id: initiate-payment
      from: APPROVED
      to: PAYMENT_INITIATED
      authorized-roles: [finance]
      guards: [payment_request_exists]
      effects: [trigger_payment_system]
    - id: close-paid-claim
      from: PAYMENT_INITIATED
      to: CLOSED
      authorized-roles: [finance]
      guards: [payment_confirmed]
      effects: [notify_member_payment_reference]
    - id: close-rejected-claim
      from: REJECTED
      to: CLOSED
      authorized-roles: [system]
      guards: [appeal_period_expired_or_member_acknowledged]
      effects: [archive_claim]

info:
  title: Claims Workflow API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Secured single-service claims workflow API. Correlation IDs use X-Correlation-ID and are separate from tracing identifiers.
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:8080/api/v1
security:
  - basicAuth: []
paths:
  /claims:
    get:
      summary: List visible claims
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Page'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Size'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/CorrelationId'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Paged claims visible to the authenticated actor
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ClaimPage' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Error' }
    post:
      summary: Create a claim
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/CorrelationId'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateClaimRequest' }
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Claim created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Claim' }
        '409': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Error' }
  /claims/{claimId}:
    parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ClaimId'
    get:
      summary: Get a claim
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Claim details
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Claim' }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Error' }
  /claims/{claimId}/facts:
    parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ClaimId'
    put:
      summary: Replace permitted claim facts
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/CorrelationId'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/UpdateFactsRequest' }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Updated claim
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Claim' }
        '409': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Error' }
  /claims/{claimId}/transitions:
    parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ClaimId'
    post:
      summary: Execute a human-authorized configured transition
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/CorrelationId'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/TransitionRequest' }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Transition result
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Claim' }
        '409': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Error' }
  /claims/{claimId}/system-transitions:
    parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ClaimId'
    post:
      summary: Execute a protected system transition
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/CorrelationId'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/TransitionRequest' }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Transition result
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Claim' }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Error' }
  /claims/{claimId}/audit:
    parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ClaimId'
    get:
      summary: Read paged immutable claim transition history
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Page'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Size'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/CorrelationId'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Ordered audit history
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuditPage' }
components:
  securitySchemes:
    basicAuth: { type: http, scheme: basic }
  parameters:
    Page:
      name: page
      in: query
      schema: { type: integer, minimum: 0, default: 0 }
    Size:
      name: size
      in: query
      schema: { type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 100, default: 20 }
    CorrelationId:
      name: X-Correlation-ID
      in: header
      schema: { type: string, maxLength: 128, pattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$' }
    IdempotencyKey:
      name: Idempotency-Key
      in: header
      required: true
      schema: { type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 128 }
    ClaimId:
      name: claimId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
  schemas:
    PageMetadata:
      type: object
      required: [items, total, page, size, totalPages]
      properties:
        items: { type: array, items: {} }
        total: { type: integer, format: int64 }
        page: { type: integer, minimum: 0 }
        size: { type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 100 }
        totalPages: { type: integer, minimum: 0 }
    ClaimPage:
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PageMetadata'
        - type: object
          properties:
            items: { type: array, items: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Claim' } }
    AuditPage:
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PageMetadata'
        - type: object
          properties:
            items: { type: array, items: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuditEntry' } }
    Claim:
      type: object
      required: [id, state, policyLimit, currency, version, facts, createdAt, updatedAt]
      properties:
        id: { type: string, format: uuid }
        state: { type: string }
        policyLimit: { type: number, minimum: 0 }
        currency: { type: string, pattern: '^[A-Z]{3}$' }
        version: { type: integer, format: int64 }
        facts: { type: object, additionalProperties: true }
        createdAt: { type: string, format: date-time }
        updatedAt: { type: string, format: date-time }
    AuditEntry:
      type: object
      required: [timestamp, fromState, toState, actorId, role]
      properties:
        timestamp: { type: string, format: date-time }
        fromState: { type: string }
        toState: { type: string }
        actorId: { type: string }
        role: { type: string }
        reason: { type: string }
    CreateClaimRequest:
      type: object
      required: [policyLimit, currency, facts]
      properties:
        policyLimit: { type: number, minimum: 0 }
        currency: { type: string, pattern: '^[A-Z]{3}$' }
        facts: { type: object, maxProperties: 100, additionalProperties: true }
    UpdateFactsRequest:
      type: object
      required: [expectedVersion, facts]
      properties:
        expectedVersion: { type: integer, format: int64, minimum: 0 }
        facts: { type: object, maxProperties: 100, additionalProperties: true }
    TransitionRequest:
      type: object
      required: [targetState, expectedVersion, facts]
      properties:
        targetState: { type: string, maxLength: 80 }
        expectedVersion: { type: integer, format: int64, minimum: 0 }
        reason: { type: string, maxLength: 2000 }
        facts: { type: object, maxProperties: 100, additionalProperties: true }
  responses:
    Error:
      description: Stable error envelope
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            type: object
            required: [code, message, correlationId]
            properties:
              code: { type: string }
              message: { type: string }
              details: { type: array, items: { type: string } }
              correlationId: { type: string }

# Quality gates

Task state is not test evidence. A worker submission becomes accepted only after
coordinator-run checks, independent review and source-matched acceptance records.

## Architecture and review

- State Machine: configured string states/edges; demonstrate a config-only addition.
- Strategy/Factory: guard/effect registries resolve supported capabilities and reject unknown IDs.
- SRP/DIP/ISP: pure engine, transactional application, small repository ports and MyBatis adapters.
- Immutable values: defensive nested facts and canonical PostgreSQL timestamp precision.
- Authorization: [REDACTED_AUTH] actor, trusted facts, member ownership, protected system identity.
- Consistency: atomic state/audit/payment/receipt/outbox, row lock/CAS, idempotent replay.
- Audit: runtime append/read only, trigger defense, no cascading deletion.
- Reliability: after-commit mock effects, retry state, no false exactly-once claim.
- Observability: real trace/span context, outcome/latency fields, no secret/medical-content logging.
- UI: dynamic states/choices, accessible forms/focus, responsive layout, escaping and clear errors.

## Acceptance cases

- C14-01: YAML loads eight initial states and nine edges with expected role/guard/effect metadata.
- C14-02: Happy path closes with five successful transition audit entries.
- C14-03: Rejection path includes reason/appeal instructions and eligible system closure.
- C14-04: Information loop resets assessment timer and clears stale completion before approval.
- C14-05: Illegal SUBMITTED-to-APPROVED edge reports source, target and available choices.
- C14-06: Unauthorized role fails at engine/application boundary without state/audit/outbox mutation.
- C14-07: Missing or invalid required documents fail with specific guard details.
- C14-08: Assessment cannot start without assigned assessor.
- C14-09: Incomplete report cannot approve/reject.
- C14-10: Amount equals limit passes; excess/negative/null/invalid currency fails appropriately.
- C14-11: Rejection and information request require nonblank reason/description.
- C14-12: Old information receipt fails; fresh server-stamped receipt permits return.
- C14-13: Payment initiation needs persisted request; closure needs confirmation/reference.
- C14-14: Appeal expiry boundary and member acknowledgement paths behave deterministically.
- C14-15: Three information requests succeed; fourth has exact escalation message; claims are independent.
- C14-16: Audit fields/order/claim scoping remain accurate and complete.
- C14-17: Runtime audit UPDATE/DELETE denied; owner trigger protects accidental mutation; no cascade.
- C14-18: Audit/outbox failure rolls back state, counter and payment request.
- C14-19: Rollback dispatches nothing; after-commit failure retains observable retry.
- C14-20: Concurrent same-version commands have one winner and no duplicate audit/payment.
- C14-21: Same actor/claim/key/payload replays result; different payload conflicts.
- C14-22: New state/edge works with configuration-only diff and dynamic interface options.
- C14-23: Duplicate/dangling/unknown guard/effect configuration fails startup clearly.
- C14-24: Terminal state has no outgoing choices.
- C14-25: HTTP401/403, ownership and system-role spoof protection.
